decisions.reason: As a low-cost ecosystem option with unresolved upside and few competing uses for its resources, the option value exceeds its carrying cost.
The bio-based binder is still uncertain and not yet central, but it offers an option on a new material market and the firm has only a medium range of alternatives.
Close to the established offer and prominently launched, the infectious waste plant remains an attractive core option whose uncertainty has not yet resolved.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant is directly core and still early-stage, making its option value high relative to the low cost of keeping it.
